entries.reason: Draft gate failed because draft wording left vague coverage terms, empty impactOnExisting, and QA evidence without the required recommendation basis.
entries.trigger: senti flow run gate --phase draft returned five blocking guardrail observations
entries.resolution: Rewrite draft.json to use measurable test wording, explicit impact statement, and QA evidence tied to issue context, guardrail principles, docs, and existing code patterns.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Draft QA answers should record the basis category and exploration evidence whenever auto mode resolves a user-facing decision.

entries.reason: senti upgrade failed after the base preset guardrail edit because preset/template validation reported missing preset chains and missing chapter templates before completion.
entries.trigger: running senti upgrade in the active worktree after modifying src/presets/base/guardrail.json
entries.resolution: Inspect upgrade artifacts and worktree changes, then decide whether a source/template correction is required or whether the failure is pre-existing environment/config state.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Upgrade-required specs should inspect upgrade-result.json and raw upgrade logs immediately when senti upgrade exits non-zero.

entries.reason: The first successful upgrade artifact still had empty checkedPaths because the globally resolved senti executable used main-repo code before the worktree fix to listUpgradeRequiredChangedPaths was available.
entries.trigger: upgrade-result.json after successful senti upgrade showed checkedPaths: [] despite an uncommitted src/presets/base/guardrail.json change
entries.resolution: Updated listUpgradeRequiredChangedPaths to include worktree status changes, added regression coverage, synced installed plugins, and reran upgrade through node src/senti.js upgrade so the worktree implementation wrote checkedPaths correctly.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Active-flow commands that write evidence should run against the active worktree implementation when the flow itself changes evidence-writing code.

entries.reason: R5 spec-local test asserted upgrade-result.json existence, but test-execute removes rebuildable artifacts before running spec-local tests, so the assertion checked the wrong responsibility.
entries.trigger: test-execute reported R5 fail with upgrade-result.json missing before spec-local test execution
entries.resolution: Changed R5 spec-local coverage to verify upgrade evidence path detection code, and will rerun upgrade after test-execute to recreate the integration gate trust artifact.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Spec-local tests should not assert artifacts that the test-execute cleanup phase deliberately removes before running tests.

entries.reason: fix: refreshed stale regression and upgrade artifacts
entries.resolution: Re-ran test-execute and test-result-review after staging changed the diff snapshot, then reran node src/senti.js upgrade so R5 upgrade-result.json and raw upgrade log are present with src/presets/base/guardrail.json in checkedPaths.
